personality_one_liner: Clean, modern, trustworthy civic tech with generous white space, subtle borders, and soft elevation shadows.

spacing.rule: Generous white space (margins lg/xl). Keep layout blocks clearly separated, allowing information to breathe without heavy borders.

do's: Use subtle glass effect on the bottom tab bar and top header to keep the civic platform feeling premium but clear.
Ensure strong backdrop tinting on glass to preserve text contrast.
dont's: Do not use glass inside the content cards or lists.

screens.name: Home Dashboard
screens.purpose: Serve as the community anchor with high-visibility hero events, a quick-action grid, and a multi-type feed.

states.loading: Skeleton UI matching the hero anchor, quick action launcher, and feed card layouts.
states.empty: Illustration of community building with 'Welcome to Sonar Shehbandh Community' text.
states.error: Readable error message 'Unable to load feed.' with a Retry button.

screens.layout:
Top Header: User avatar on left, bell icon with red unread dot on right (using brandSecondary for icons).
Section 1: Pinned / Hero Anchor banner spanning screen width minus margin. Dark gradient overlay with event title, RSVP counters, and date badges. 
Section 2: Quick Action Launcher. Horizontal scrolling grid of icons/chips with notification badges. 
Section 3: Rich Feed. Cards for notices, business, and volunteer features. Official notices should highlight author role and have attachment tiles.

screens.name: Directory Hub & List
screens.purpose: A filterable list of members, businesses, and social workers providing immediate utility via quick actions.

states.empty: Icon of empty folder + 'No directory items match your filters.' + 'Clear Filters' CTA.
states.error: Error message 'Unable to load directory.' + Retry button.

screens.layout:
Top: Sticky Search bar and horizontal sub-caste/category filter chips.
List Rows: Use elevated cards (`surfaceSecondary` with shadow tier 1) since they contain mixed media/actions. 
Card Anatomy: Left - Photo thumbnail; Center - Title, subtitle, sub-caste tag, and prominent 'FEATURED' badge (brandPrimary teal); Bottom - Action pair (Quick Call vs WhatsApp). Phone number gated state shows 'Unlock with plan' lock icon instead of numbers.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the provided user color palette (surface #FBF7EE, brand maroon #8B1818, brandPrimary teal #008080, brandSecondary navy #0A2540).
Typography must be Plus Jakarta Sans exclusively, maximum font weight 500. Hierarchy is established through size, not weight.
Implement the 'Quick Action Launcher' on the Home screen as a horizontal scrolling list of circular/rounded chips with icons and notification dots.
For the Directory list, implement 'ElevatedCards' containing a left-aligned avatar, text block in the middle, and bottom row reserved for Quick Actions (Call/WhatsApp).
Where business phone numbers are gated, display a lock icon and 'Unlock with plan' text instead of hiding the action completely.
Global navigation: Build a persistent top bar featuring the user avatar and notification bell (with unread dot). Construct the bottom tab bar with an active state pill indicator.
When applying text over the Hero Event banner, use a vertical gradient scrim (transparent to surfaceInverse) to guarantee WCAG contrast.
